```lean
theorem lg_target {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module ℤ_[p] E] [IsBoundedSMul ℤ_[p] E] [IsUltrametricDist E] (f : C(ℤ_[p], E)) : Filter.Tendsto (fun x => (fwdDiff 1)^[x] (⇑f) 0) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
  intro n
  induction' n with d hd
  · simp only [functor.pow_zero, nat.cast_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds
  · rw [functor.pow_succ, fwdDiff_pow]
    simp only [nat.cast_succ, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_left_inj]
    have : (fwdDiff 1)^[d + 1] (⇑f) 0 = (fwdDiff 1)^[d] (fwdDiff 1 (⇑f)) 0
    rw [this]
    refine' tendsto.comp _ (tendsto_const_nhds)
    exact tendsto_id
    exact hd
```
